query: UPDATE meta_messaging_message m SET media_state=CASE WHEN $3 THEN 'stored' ELSE 'failed' END,effect_revision=effect_revision+1,event_published_at=NULL,native_retry_at=now() WHERE connection_id=$1 AND provider_message_id=$2 AND ($3 OR m.media_state<>'stored') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meta_messaging_revision r WHERE r.connection_id=m.connection_id AND r.customer_id=m.customer_id AND r.provider_message_id=m.provider_message_id AND r.direction=m.direction AND r.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
